title: The ordinary balanced tensor transpose has the full strict quotient coordinates
statement: For arbitrary complexes P,Q of completed-coefficient modules, let G be ordinary coherent reduction and B the total tensor of G(P),G(Q). Any strict chain map psi from G(total(P,Q)) to B whose finite chain components are the prescribed coefficientScalarTensorIso has ordinary adjunction transpose, followed by the ordinary zero-homotopy Roos lift and the fixed strict tensor-tower comparison, equal to StrictTensorAugmentation.map(P,Q). This assertion uses neither derived categories nor good-complex hypotheses. The adjunction and tower comparisons are [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-realizations], the scalar tensor component is [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus], and the target augmentation is [lem-pur-strict-tensor-augmentation-construction].

source.place: Tags 07A4, 07A6 and 0941; ordinary scalar tensor units, the tensor/limit Hom correspondence and the full zero-homotopy Roos augmentation.

proof.text: Project the ordinary zero-homotopy Roos lift and its tensor-tower map to the nth product factor using roos_projection. Apply tensorReduction_finiteProjection to the assumed finite normalization: it gives exactly the finite scalar adjunction transpose of the prescribed tensor comparison.

Apply tensorReduction_finiteTransposeCoordinates, whose proved generator calculation identifies that finite transpose with the nth strict augmentation coordinate. Product extensionality gives the first coordinate. The Roos map preserves the shifted coordinate and the ordinary lift has shifted coordinate zero; StrictTensorAugmentation.coordinates gives the same zero coordinate. The mapping-cocone hom extensionality theorem combines the two equalities.

theorem tensorReduction_ordinaryTranspose (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ) :
    let T := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)).obj (P, Q)
    let G := (pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let B := (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
      (coefficientSequenceTopology (Scheme.ProEt.topology W))
      (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W)).obj (G.obj P, G.obj Q)
    ∀ ψ : G.obj T ⟶ B,
      (∀ n : ℕ,
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E W n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map ψ ≫
          (coefficientEvaluationTensorIso l E W n (G.obj P) (G.obj Q)).hom ≫
          (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology W)
            (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E W n)).map
            (Prod.mkHom ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).inv.app P)
              ((pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).inv.app Q)) =
        (pullbackTensorReductionEvaluationComplex l E W n).inv.app T ≫
          (coefficientScalarTensorIso l E W n P Q).hom) →
      ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryAdjunction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).homEquiv
          T B ψ ≫
        (Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
          (Iso.refl (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W ⋙
            pullbackTensorConstantLimit l E W)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app B ≫
        pullbackTensorRoosUnit l E W
          (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj B) ≫
        integralOperationsRoosMap (pullbackTensorTensorTower l E W P Q).hom =
      (StrictTensorAugmentation.map l E W).app (P, Q)
